subgraph._note: No concrete The Graph deployment id was found in the source repo (kaonone/starknet-bridge-subgraph) or its config. The subgraph names in config/ are 'in19farkt/starknet-bridge-stable' (mainnet, hosted-service style) and 'in19farkt/starknet-bridge-staging' (goerli). The hosted service is deprecated and these are community-maintained (kaonone) and stale (last source commit 2022-02-02), so a live decentralized-network endpoint may not exist. To validate, deploy/locate the subgraph, set url to https://gateway.thegraph.com/api/subgraphs/id/<ID> and provide GRAPH_API_KEY. NOTE: the source ships NO mainnet bridge-address config (config/stable.json is all zero-addresses), so the original mainnet deployment, if any, used a different rendered bridge set than this port's StarkGate registry — filtered entity sets may differ. See MIGRATION.md.
